name: Molodost pakhnet letom
source:
The year is 1998. The once-famous Soviet camp Sovyonok is going through tough times. The camp counselor, Olga Dmitrievna, with the help of the protagonists, Kostya and Yulya, is organizing a concert to support the camp. To get help, the protagonists will have to turn to other squads. Not all the squads get along, so the task won't be an easy one. All of this is complicated by the arrival of two newcomers who are late for the shift and promise chaos with their appearance.

The narrative is told simultaneously from both the end and the beginning of the events, and everything must eventually converge in the middle, at the deciding point. Will the heroes manage to organize the concert and save the camp?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3497111000]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是1998年，曾经著名的苏联集中营索维诺克 (Sovyonok) 正在经历艰难的时期。营地辅导员Olga Dmitrievna在主角Kostya和Yulya的帮助下，正在组织一场音乐会来支持营地。为了获得帮助，主角们必须求助于其他小队。并不是所有的小队都相处得很好，所以这项任务并不容易。两名新员工的到来使所有这一切变得更加复杂，他们上班迟到了，而且他们的外表可能会造成混乱。

叙述从事件的结束和开始同时讲述，一切最终都必须汇聚到中间的决定点。英雄们能否成功组织音乐会并拯救营地？

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3497111000]Steam[/url]]
